integrity: The source definition, first-listed MSC 30C45, coefficient results, extremal construction, and stated future geometric direction were checked in the full open-access article. The new minimization is reduced analytically to the boundary real-part function; endpoint arcs are bounded symbolically and the unique interior critical point is certified by an included interval-arithmetic checker.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the sharp convexity order of the classical Ma--Minda class generated by xi(z)=1+sin(z)/(1-z). It does not treat the q-deformed classes, uniform convexity, or the complete geometry of xi(D). The sharp constant is characterized by a unique transcendental critical point rather than an elementary closed form.
title: Sharp order of convexity for the sine-over-pole Ma--Minda class
